title: REQ · game vitest config aliases phaser, added by a Verify-owned unit
summary: phaser alias resolves to the frontend install and is owned by Verify
description: The alias for 'phaser' pointing to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser is added to game/vitest.config.ts within the Verify unit, since it is a test configuration file, and BootScene's default import of phaser stays compatible with it.
acceptance_criteria: Given vitest.config.ts, when loaded, then alias 'phaser' resolves to game/frontend/node_modules/phaser and '@game' still resolves to game/src
Given BootScene.ts, when read, then it default-imports 'phaser' so the alias applies
technical_constraints: Alias path must be computed with fileURLToPath like the @game alias
definition_of_done: Alias added in Verify unit; test passes
